videos.hipthrust: She performs barbell hip thrusts with perfect form: upper back on the bench, she drives through her heels and lifts her hips until her torso and thighs form a straight line, chin tucked, squeezes her glutes at the top, then lowers her hips slowly. The one barbell stays on her hips the whole time. Slow controlled reps. Static camera from the side.
videos.bulgarian: She performs Bulgarian split squats with perfect form: rear foot on the bench, she lowers straight down until her front thigh is parallel to the floor, front knee over her foot, torso upright, then drives up through the front heel. One dumbbell stays in each hand the whole time. Slow controlled reps. Static camera from the side.
videos.dbrow: She performs one-arm dumbbell rows with perfect form: back flat, she pulls the dumbbell up to her hip with her elbow close to her body, squeezes her shoulder blade, then lowers it slowly until the arm is straight. Her knee and hand stay on the bench and the one dumbbell stays in her hand. Static camera from the side.
videos.dbbench: She performs dumbbell bench presses with perfect form: shoulder blades pulled back, feet on the floor, she lowers both dumbbells slowly to the sides of her chest with elbows at about 45 degrees, then presses them back up over her chest. One dumbbell stays in each hand the whole time. Static camera from the side.
